clips.title: The story
paras: The Eastern Plaguelands represent the devastated heart of the fallen Kingdom of Lordaeron, suffocated under Scourge blight, toxic mists, and corrupted fungal growths. Stratholme looms in the north as the undead power base in the region, while the zealous Scarlet Crusade entrenches in the east. Amid the nightmare, Light's Hope Chapel stands as a resolute, neutral sanctuary for anyone brave enough to fight back.

Once known as the fertile Eastweald, this region was the agricultural spine of northern Lordaeron, anchored by the great metropolis of Stratholme and prosperous towns like Darrowshire and Corin's Crossing. During the Third War, Prince Arthas purged Stratholme after discovering its grain supply had been laced with the Plague of Undeath. Following the kingdom's collapse, the Scourge's dark magic ran unchecked. The soil turned brown and rotten, ordinary flora warped into colossal mushrooms, and an eerie orange mist settled across the valleys.

Stratholme serves as the southern seat of Scourge authority in Lordaeron, commanded by Baron Rivendare under the direction of the lich Kel'Thuzad. Defying the undead from the southeast is the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, which has fortified the town of Tyr's Hand and assaults Stratholme's scarlet bastions. Their dogmatic hatred extends beyond the dead to any living traveler who crosses their borders. To the north, the Mossflayer forest trolls of Zul'Mashar wage their own isolated, desperate campaigns, caught in the crossfire of the greater conflict.

Survival in the Eastern Plaguelands requires careful footing. The neutral Argent Dawn operates out of Light's Hope Chapel in the far east, offering a safe haven, essential supplies, and flight routes to both Alliance and Horde champions. Beyond the chapel, the ruined watchtowers of Crown Guard, Eastwall, Northpass, and Plaguewood stand as silent reminders of Lordaeron's lost defenses.
